 Dated this the 8th day of April, 2025

Order 
This bail application is filed under Section 482 of Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita (BNSS).

The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 376(2)(n), 354-D, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC') and also under Sections 3(2)(v), 3(1)(s) and 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015).
2.

entities.text: Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
When this bail application came up for consideration before this Court on 04.04.2025, this Court passed the following order:-
"Petitioner shall not be arrested till the next posting date.

Lookout circular, if any,
shall be kept in abeyance till the next 2025:KER:30596 posting date.
The petitioner shall surrender his passport before the Investigating Officer on Monday at 10 a.m. The Investigating Officer can interrogate the petitioner, if necessary."
3. It is submitted that the petitioner already surrendered before the Investigating Officer.

Since the offence under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015) is alleged against the petitioner, the petitioner has to move the Special Court under Section 482 of BNSS.

opennyai_summary.decision:
The offences alleged against the petitioner are under Sections 376(2)(n), 354-D, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (for short 'IPC') and also under Sections 3(2)(v), 3(1)(s) and 3(2)(va) of the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015).
2.
When this bail application came up for consideration before this Court on 04.04.2025, this Court passed the following order:-
"Petitioner shall not be arrested till the next posting date.
Lookout circular, if any,
shall be kept in abeyance till the next 2025:KER:30596 posting date.
The petitioner shall surrender his passport before the Investigating Officer on Monday at 10 a.m. The Investigating Officer can interrogate the petitioner, if necessary."
3. It is submitted that the petitioner already surrendered before the Investigating Officer.
Since the offence under the Scheduled Castes and Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act, 1989 (Amendment 2015) is alleged against the petitioner, the petitioner has to move the Special Court under Section 482 of BNSS.
Granting liberty to file an application before the Special Court, this bail application is disposed of.
To facilitate the petitioner to file an application before the Special Court, the petitioner shall not be arrested for a period 10 days.
